title: Nadella Opens Up: Don't Just Trust OpenAI and Anthropic, Microsoft Will Be the Cheapest
excerpt: Microsoft is in an unprecedented delicate position - both one of the world's largest cloud service providers and holding significant shares in two leading AI la
content_html:
Microsoft is in an unprecedented delicate position - both one of the world's largest cloud service providers and holding significant shares in two leading AI labs, OpenAI and Anthropic. However, as both companies continue to expand into the application layer and intelligent agent infrastructure, trying to directly control customer relationships, CEO Satya Nadella clearly isn't going to let this trend threaten Microsoft's cash cow.

Microsoft has just released a stunning quarterly report: revenue of $90 billion and net profit of $35.8 billion for the fourth quarter, and total revenue of $331.8 billion and net profit of $133.7 billion for the 2026 fiscal year. Nadella's strategy is clear - he has repeatedly warned enterprise customers recently not to rely solely on cutting-edge AI labs' models, as binding intelligent agent frameworks with underlying models is dangerous because it means handing over a large amount of internal secrets to model vendors whose credibility is questionable.

From the Hugging Face incident to self-developed MAI, Microsoft reveals its entire hand

In the Wednesday earnings call, Nadella directly laid out his cards to Wall Street analysts: this is Microsoft's opportunity. He outlined the core architectural principle of "separating intelligent agent frameworks from models," ensuring that any model can be replaced at any time - and Microsoft sells a range of intelligent agent frameworks under the Copilot brand, including GitHub Copilot. He even used last week's Hugging Face intrusion incident as evidence: after an unannounced model from OpenAI broke through the sandbox and invaded Hugging Face, the latter initially tried to use a private cutting-edge model to analyze the attack, but the model refused to help, and ultimately had to turn to the Chinese open-source model Z.ai GLM 5.2 to complete the defense.

Nadella also revealed Microsoft's self-developed arsenal: the MAI series models paired with self-developed Maya chips, which achieve a 40% performance improvement per watt when running on Maya 200. Microsoft Cloud offers more than 11,000 models, covering OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, and the self-developed MAI family. The newly released MAI Cyber One Flash claims to surpass the larger Mythos model from Anthropic at half the cost. Nadella's message is clear enough: cutting-edge models can be used, but shouldn't be trusted to the point of dependence - and Microsoft will be the option that allows you to switch anytime and affordably.

content_html_zh:
微软正处于前所未有的微妙境地——它既是全球最大的云服务提供商之一，又在两个领先的人工智能实验室 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 中持有大量股份。 然而，随着两家公司不断向应用层和智能代理基础设施扩张，试图直接控制客户关系，首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉(Satya Nadella)显然不会让这种趋势威胁到微软的摇钱树。

微软刚刚发布了令人震惊的季报：第四季度营收900亿美元，净利润358亿美元，2026财年总营收3318亿美元，净利润1337亿美元。 纳德拉的策略很明确——他最近多次警告企业客户不要仅仅依赖尖端人工智能实验室的模型，因为将智能代理框架与底层模型绑定是危险的，因为这意味着将大量内部机密交给可信度值得怀疑的模型供应商。

从抱脸事件到自研MAI，微软露出一手好牌

在周三的财报电话会议上，纳德拉直接向华尔街分析师摊牌：这是微软的机会。 他概述了“将智能代理框架与模型分离”的核心架构原则，确保任何模型都可以随时更换——微软以 Copilot 品牌销售一系列智能代理框架，包括 GitHub Copilot。 他甚至以上周的Hugging Face入侵事件为证据：在OpenAI的一个未公布的模型突破沙箱并入侵Hugging Face后，后者最初尝试使用私人尖端模型来分析攻击，但该模型拒绝提供帮助，最终不得不求助于中国开源模型Z.ai GLM 5.2来完成防御。

纳德拉还透露了微软自研的武器库：MAI系列机型搭配自研的Maya芯片，在Maya 200上运行时每瓦性能提升40%。 微软云提供超过11000个模型，涵盖OpenAI、Anthropic、Mistral、xAI以及自研的MAI家族。 新发布的 MAI Cyber​​ One Flash 声称以一半的成本超越了 Anthropic 的更大的 Mythos 模型。 纳德拉的信息非常明确：可以使用尖端模型，但不应信任到依赖的程度 - 微软将是允许您随时以经济实惠的方式进行切换的选择。
